name: Kagura Nanami
source:
She's sweet, kind-hearted and cheerful girl. She's sweet, kind-hearted and a constant bundle of energy. Nanami immediately takes you under her wing and gives you the initial tour of the Fujisawa Academy.

But underneath all that rampant enthusiasm for life, you soon detect just a twinge of sadness. What's bothering her? Why is she so obsessed with the 'Curse of Mikoto' - one of the seven mysteries of Fujisawa?

[From [url=https://kotodama.fandom.com/wiki/Nanami_Kagura]Fandom[/url]]
